description: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs: CertPool derives Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq but not Clone. CertPool holds Vec<Certificate> and Certificate: Clone, so Clone is derivable. The absence of Clone forces callers to rebuild the pool from scratch when they need two independent copies (e.g., testing the same pool against different path-building scenarios in parallel). The doc comment notes Hash cannot be derived due to upstream Certificate not implementing Hash, but Clone has no such obstacle.
title: CertPool missing Clone derive
